name: New Horizons
description: New Horizons adds six magic schools, revised Skills and perks, and 32 revised existing hero specialties. Leadership coordinates arbitrarily large stacks through square-root direct-attack efficiency; all seven army slots are unrestricted. Authority raises effective Leadership; Discipline governs Morale and Warfare specializes in Orders. Every acquired Skill rank immediately grants one mandatory choice from its complete perk tier. Ordinary Castle defaults replace Griffins with Swordsmen, except for Griffin specialists. Fresh neutrals use 100% stock counts without Leadership calibration; recruitment growth remains separately 50%. Magic Arrow Overcharge, Elemental Attunement and the Fast/Full quick-combat choice are retained. In-battle auto-resolve uses fast Quick Combat AI. This Leadership migration requires a new game, including from 0.90; older saves are not converted or rewritten. The current and minimum save format is 1159; earlier saves are rejected before payload loading. Generated by tools/update-new-horizons-module.py from config/newHorizons*.json. Primary growth grants a fixed twenty-point class vector on every level, plus independent configured skill-based bonus rolls. Future mastery and creature-tier work remains separate. Siege retains skill-trained ballista scaling. Separate future Artillery mastery candidate: one permanent extra choice after a level gained with prior Expert Artillery. Not secondary rank four or completion of other mastery families, creature tiers or new spell effects. Includes the 32-Skill, ten-perk registry; configured active entries require corresponding runtime and gameplay verification while remaining entries stay planned. Includes independently authored quick-save/load buttons and creature ability icons; landscape presentation only. Selectively reviewed hero biography rewrites replace only entries proven stronger than the installed originals.

new-horizons:spellcraft.name: Spellcraft
new-horizons:spellcraft.description: Strengthen spells from every magic school.

basic.description: Your spells gain +10% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

effect.description: Your spells gain +10% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

basic.details: Spell Power-derived numerical components of spells operate at 110% Spellcraft Efficiency.

advanced.description: Your spells gain +20% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

effect.description: Your spells gain +20% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

expert.description: Your spells gain +30% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

effect.description: Your spells gain +30% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

perks.name: Cross-School Formula
perks.description: After casting a spell, your next spell this round or next gains +10% Spell Power contribution if both have schools and share none.

effect.description: After casting a spell, your next spell this round or next gains +10% Spell Power contribution if both have schools and share none.

perks.details: After your hero casts a combat spell, their next combat spell this round or next gains +10% to the part of its effect determined by Spell Power. Both spells must belong to at least one magic school and have no school in common. The comparison always uses your hero's last combat spell, even if it was countered or resisted.

perks.name: Spell Penetration
perks.description: Hostile spells ignore 20% of the target's Magical Damage Reduction.

effect.description: Hostile spells ignore 20% of the target's Magical Damage Reduction.

perks.name: Concentration
perks.description: Single-target spells gain +15% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

effect.description: Single-target spells gain +15% to the part of their effect determined by Spell Power.

perks.details:
Strengthen combat spells that target just one creature stack.

The part of the effect that scales with Spell Power gains +15%. Targets still count if they resist or would be chosen at random.

perks.name: Arcane Focus
perks.description: The first spell cast in each combat receives +20% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

effect.description: The first spell cast in each combat receives +20% to its Spell Power-derived numerical component.

perks.name: Extend Spell
perks.description: Once per round, your first accepted spell with a temporary round-based effect lasts 1 additional round.

effect.description: Once per round, your first accepted spell with a temporary round-based effect lasts 1 additional round.

perks.details: Once per round, the first accepted hero combat spell with a positive round-based temporary lifetime lasts 1 additional round. Permanent, combat-long and action-bound effects do not qualify.

perks.name: Precise Casting
perks.description: Friendly stacks at the center of your conventional area spells are unaffected; indiscriminate spells such as Armageddon are excluded.

effect.description: Friendly stacks at the center of your conventional area spells are unaffected; indiscriminate spells such as Armageddon are excluded.

perks.details: When a conventional area spell with a selected central hex is centered on a hex occupied by a friendly stack, that stack is excluded from the spell's effect. Spells explicitly defined as indiscriminate, such as Armageddon, cannot benefit.

perks.name: Empower Spell
perks.description: Spells whose final Wisdom-adjusted Mana cost is 12 or higher receive +25% to their Spell Power-derived numerical component.

effect.description: Spells whose final Wisdom-adjusted Mana cost is 12 or higher receive +25% to their Spell Power-derived numerical component.

perks.name: Counterpressure
perks.description: After an enemy spell affects your army, your next spell this round or next gains +20% Spell Power contribution.

effect.description: After an enemy spell affects your army, your next spell this round or next gains +20% Spell Power contribution.

perks.details: After an enemy hero casts a spell that affects your army, your next spell before the end of the next round receives +20% to its Spell Power-derived component.

perks.name: Grand Formula
perks.description: The first Level 4 or Level 5 spell cast in each combat uses 150% of its normal Spell Power-derived numerical component before other multipliers.

effect.description: The first Level 4 or Level 5 spell cast in each combat uses 150% of its normal Spell Power-derived numerical component before other multipliers.

perks.name: Overwhelming Formula
perks.description: Your first hostile damaging spell each combat ignores 50% of affected targets’ Magical Damage Reduction.

effect.description: Your first hostile damaging spell each combat ignores 50% of affected targets’ Magical Damage Reduction.

perks.details: The first hostile spell each combat that deals magical damage to one or more stacks with Magical Damage Reduction ignores 50% of each affected target's current Magical Damage Reduction.

new-horizons:wisdom.name: Wisdom
new-horizons:wisdom.description: Reduce spell Mana costs and improve Knowledge; Magic School Skills unlock higher-level spells.

basic.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 10%.

effect.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 10%.

advanced.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 20%.

effect.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 20%.

expert.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 30%.

effect.description: Listed spell Mana costs are reduced by 30%.

perks.name: Intelligence
perks.description: Increase maximum Mana by 30% through effective Knowledge.

effect.description: Increase maximum Mana by 30% through effective Knowledge.

perks.details: Maximum Normal Spell Points equal floor(1.30 × effective Knowledge). Intelligence is the sole general multiplicative capacity effect.

perks.name: Mysticism
perks.description: Recover at least 5 Mana each day, up to maximum Mana.

effect.description: Recover at least 5 Mana each day, up to maximum Mana.

perks.details: At the start of each day, recover the greater of 5 or floor(10% of maximum Mana), capped at maximum Normal Spell Points.

perks.name: Spell Familiarity
perks.description: Repeated casts of the same spell cost less Mana during combat.

effect.description: Repeated casts of the same spell cost less Mana during combat.

perks.details: Each prior accepted hero cast of the same combat spell reduces its Wisdom-discounted Mana cost by another 5%; round up, minimum 1 Mana. Cost = max(1, ceil(Wisdom-discounted cost × max(0, 100 − 5 × prior casts) / 100)). Count each spell independently by its spell identifier, including distinct mass variants. Reset at the start of combat. Accepted casts count even when free or their effect is negated; rejected or canceled casts and Echo repetitions do not count.

perks.name: Arcane Momentum
perks.description: Casting in consecutive combat rounds builds spell effectiveness, up to 20%.

effect.description: Casting in consecutive combat rounds builds spell effectiveness, up to 20%.

perks.details: After the first completed hero cast in a combat round, gain 5% spell effectiveness for subsequent casts, up to 20%. Gain at most once per round. Casting in consecutive rounds maintains the buildup; a round without a hero spell cast resets it. The triggering cast uses the previous bonus, including 0% on the first cast. Reset at the start of combat.

perks.name: Spell Scholar
perks.description: Pay 25% less for Adventure spells purchased during Mage Guild visits.

effect.description: Pay 25% less for Adventure spells purchased during Mage Guild visits.

perks.details: While the owning hero visits a Mage Guild, Adventure spell purchases cost 25% fewer resources. Round each positive resource cost up after multiplying it by 75%; zero costs remain zero. Normal purchase and learning requirements still apply. Combat spells and all other purchases receive no discount.

perks.name: Mana Fasting
perks.description: Recover 10% of maximum Mana after winning combat without casting a hero spell.

effect.description: Recover 10% of maximum Mana after winning combat without casting a hero spell.

perks.details: After victory with no completed hero spell casts during that combat, recover floor(10% of maximum Mana), capped at maximum Normal Spell Points. A completed cast counts even when free or its effect is negated; rejected or canceled casts do not count.

perks.name: Mana Conservation
perks.description: After combat, recover 20% of Mana spent, up to 20 Mana and maximum Mana.

effect.description: After combat, recover 20% of Mana spent, up to 20 Mana and maximum Mana.

perks.details: After combat, recover floor(20% of the Mana actually spent during that combat), capped at 20 Mana and maximum Normal Spell Points.

perks.name: Arcane Insight
perks.description: The first cast of each distinct spell in combat gains 25% effectiveness.

effect.description: The first cast of each distinct spell in combat gains 25% effectiveness.

perks.details: The first completed hero cast of each distinct combat spell gains 25% spell effectiveness. Track each spell independently and reset at the start of combat. Rejected or canceled casts do not consume the bonus.

perks.name: Archmage
perks.description: Level 4 and 5 spells gain 20% effectiveness and 10% Spell Penetration.

effect.description: Level 4 and 5 spells gain 20% effectiveness and 10% Spell Penetration.

perks.details: Every Level 4 or Level 5 spell cast gains 20% spell effectiveness and 10 percentage points of Spell Penetration. This perk does not reduce Mana costs.

perks.name: Sage
perks.description: Gain 50 effective Knowledge while this perk is owned.

effect.description: Gain 50 effective Knowledge while this perk is owned.

perks.details: Add 50 to effective Knowledge once while this perk is owned. Base Knowledge does not change; Intelligence applies to the resulting effective Knowledge when calculating maximum Mana.

new-horizons:warcasting.name: Warcasting
new-horizons:warcasting.description: Hero combat spells inspire friendly attacks and retaliations.

basic.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +5% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

effect.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +5% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

basic.details: Arcane Inspiration grants +5% damage to friendly attacks and retaliations after a successful hero combat spell. It expires at the start of the next combat round; another successful spell refreshes it without stacking. Creature abilities and damage over time receive no bonus.

advanced.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +10% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

effect.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +10% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

advanced.details: Arcane Inspiration grants +10% damage to friendly attacks and retaliations after a successful hero combat spell. It expires at the start of the next combat round; another successful spell refreshes it without stacking. Creature abilities and damage over time receive no bonus.

expert.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +15% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

effect.description: Hero combat spells grant friendly stacks +15% attack and retaliation damage until the next round.

expert.details: Arcane Inspiration grants +15% damage to friendly attacks and retaliations after a successful hero combat spell. It expires at the start of the next combat round; another successful spell refreshes it without stacking. Creature abilities and damage over time receive no bonus.

perks.name: Spellward
perks.description: Friendly stacks take 10% less magical damage.

effect.description: Friendly stacks take 10% less magical damage.

perks.details: This passive 10% magical damage reduction applies whether or not Arcane Inspiration is active. Preserve the existing magical damage reduction and immunity rules.

perks.name: Arcane Valor
perks.description: Inspired friendly stacks gain +1 Morale.

effect.description: Inspired friendly stacks gain +1 Morale.

perks.details: While Arcane Inspiration is active, friendly stacks gain +1 Morale under the ordinary Morale limits and immunities. Lingering Inspiration does not retain this Morale bonus.

perks.name: Spellshock
perks.description: Enemies damaged by hero combat spells deal 10% less damage until the next round.

effect.description: Enemies damaged by hero combat spells deal 10% less damage until the next round.

perks.details: Enemy stacks actually damaged by a successful hero combat spell deal 10% less outgoing attack and retaliation damage until the start of the next combat round. A resisted or negated spell that deals no damage does not apply Spellshock; refresh without stacking. Creature abilities and damage over time are not weakened.

perks.name: Battle Focus
perks.description: Inspired friendly retaliations deal an additional 15% damage.

effect.description: Inspired friendly retaliations deal an additional 15% damage.

perks.details: While Arcane Inspiration is active, add 15 percentage points to its core damage bonus for friendly retaliations only. At Basic, Advanced and Expert Warcasting this totals +20%, +25% and +30%, before Grand Inspiration. Lingering Inspiration retains only the core bonus, not Battle Focus.

perks.name: Arcane Bulwark
perks.description: Inspired friendly stacks take 10% less physical damage.

effect.description: Inspired friendly stacks take 10% less physical damage.

perks.details: While Arcane Inspiration is active, friendly stacks receive 10% less physical damage through the existing physical damage reduction rules. Lingering Inspiration does not retain this protection.

perks.name: Enchanted Weapons
perks.description: Inspired friendly attacks ignore 15% of enemy Defense.

effect.description: Inspired friendly attacks ignore 15% of enemy Defense.

perks.details: While Arcane Inspiration is active, friendly attacks and retaliations ignore 15% of the target’s Defense. This is a percentage of Defense, not a flat reduction of 15 Defense. Lingering Inspiration does not retain this perk.

perks.name: Lingering Inspiration
perks.description: Each spell preserves Inspiration’s damage bonus for one attack beyond its duration, unless used earlier.

effect.description: Each spell preserves Inspiration’s damage bonus for one attack beyond its duration, unless used earlier.

perks.details: Each successful hero combat spell grants each inspired stack one nonstacking retained charge of the core damage bonus, including Grand Inspiration. The first accepted attack strike, including a retaliation, consumes that charge even while normal Arcane Inspiration remains active; rejected attacks do not consume it. This is one strike rather than an entire multistrike sequence. Normal active inspiration continues until the start of the next combat round, but active and retained core bonuses never double. Only an unspent charge carries beyond expiry; expiry creates no fresh charge for a stack that already attacked. Retained inspiration grants no other inspiration perk effects. Recasting refreshes or replaces the one charge without stacking.

perks.name: Arcane Reprisal
perks.description: Inspired friendly stacks reflect 10% of incoming attack damage as magical damage.

effect.description: Inspired friendly stacks reflect 10% of incoming attack damage as magical damage.

perks.details: An inspired friendly defender reflects 10% of incoming enemy attack damage remaining after temporary shields back to its attacker as magical damage, including damage from retaliations. A fully absorbed hit reflects zero. Capture inspiration and this perk before casualties or attack-lifetime effects are removed, so a lethal hit still qualifies. Apply the ordinary magical mitigation rules to reflected damage; reflection cannot trigger itself or another reprisal and grants no extra action. Lingering Inspiration does not retain this perk.

perks.name: Grand Inspiration
perks.description: Arcane Inspiration grants an additional 10% attack and retaliation damage.

effect.description: Arcane Inspiration grants an additional 10% attack and retaliation damage.

perks.details: Add 10 percentage points to Arcane Inspiration’s core damage bonus, making Basic, Advanced and Expert totals +15%, +20% and +25%. This remains the core bonus retained by Lingering Inspiration; it does not add a separate stack.

perks.name: Arcane Supremacy
perks.description: Inspired friendly attacks ignore 20% of applicable physical and magical damage reduction.

effect.description: Inspired friendly attacks ignore 20% of applicable physical and magical damage reduction.

perks.details: While Arcane Inspiration is active, friendly attacks and retaliations ignore 20% of applicable Physical Damage Reduction and Magical Damage Reduction through their existing independent mitigation stages. This does not ignore Defense or improve hero spells. Lingering Inspiration does not retain this perk.

new-horizons:warcasting.details: After a successful hero combat spell, friendly stacks gain Arcane Inspiration until the start of the next combat round. Refresh the effect without stacking. It improves attacks and retaliations, not creature abilities or damage over time. Arcane Inspiration is not a hero spell buff and grants no additional Hero Action. The ordinary shared Spell-or-Order action limit and explicit faction exceptions remain unchanged. Successful automatic hero spells also trigger it; Echo repetitions are not spell casts. Capture friendly stacks after the triggering spell’s effects, including friendly stacks summoned by that spell; later arrivals receive inspiration only after another successful hero spell refreshes it. Rejected, canceled or explicitly negated casts do not trigger inspiration.

new-horizons:logistics.name: Logistics
new-horizons:logistics.description: Increase adventure movement and improve travel.

basic.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 10%.

effect.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 10%.

advanced.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 20%.

effect.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 20%.

expert.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 30%.

effect.description: Adventure-map Movement increases by 30%.

perks.name: Pathfinding
perks.description: Difficult-terrain movement penalties are reduced by 50%.

effect.description: Difficult-terrain movement penalties are reduced by 50%.

perks.name: Navigation
perks.description: Sea Movement increases by 25%, and embark/disembark Movement costs are halved.

effect.description: Sea Movement increases by 25%, and embark/disembark Movement costs are halved.

perks.name: Scouting
perks.description: Adventure-map sight radius increases by 5 hexes.

effect.description: Adventure-map sight radius increases by 5 hexes.

perks.name: Forced March
perks.description: Once daily after exhausting Movement, gain 10% extra maximum Movement; your army suffers -1 Morale in its next combat’s first round that day.

effect.description: Once daily after exhausting Movement, gain 10% extra maximum Movement; your army suffers -1 Morale in its next combat’s first round that day.

perks.details: Once per day after exhausting normal Movement, gain additional Movement equal to 10% of maximum Movement. The army begins its next combat that day with -1 Morale during round 1.

perks.name: Roadmaster
perks.description: Movement cost while travelling on roads is reduced by an additional 25% relative to the normal road cost.

effect.description: Movement cost while travelling on roads is reduced by an additional 25% relative to the normal road cost.

perks.name: Mountaineer
perks.description: Rough and Subterranean terrain impose no additional movement penalty. Impassable Rock remains impassable; other terrain penalties are unchanged.

effect.description: Rough and Subterranean terrain impose no additional movement penalty. Impassable Rock remains impassable; other terrain penalties are unchanged.

perks.name: Rapid Embarkation
perks.description: Embarking or disembarking costs only 10% of maximum daily Movement.

effect.description: Embarking or disembarking costs only 10% of maximum daily Movement.

perks.name: Pursuit March
perks.description: After winning a combat, recover 10% of maximum daily Movement. Once per day.

effect.description: After winning a combat, recover 10% of maximum daily Movement. Once per day.

perks.name: Wayfarer
perks.description: Passable terrain can never cost more than 125% of its base clear-terrain movement cost.

effect.description: Passable terrain can never cost more than 125% of its base clear-terrain movement cost.

perks.name: Master Logistician
perks.description: Up to 15% of unused Movement at the end of a day carries over to the next day.

effect.description: Up to 15% of unused Movement at the end of a day carries over to the next day.

new-horizons:diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
new-horizons:diplomacy.description: Improve negotiations with eligible neutral creatures; scripted and hostile encounters may be excluded.

basic.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 25% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

effect.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 25% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

basic.details: An eligible neutral stack with Army Value no greater than 25% of the hero's current army may offer to join for its normal recruitment gold cost.

advanced.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 50% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

effect.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 50% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

advanced.details: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 50% of the hero's Army Value.

expert.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 75% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

effect.description: Eligible neutral stacks worth up to 75% of your army’s value may join for their normal recruitment Gold cost.

expert.details: The deterministic joining threshold becomes 75% of the hero's Army Value.

perks.name: Negotiator
perks.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by 15 percentage points.

effect.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by 15 percentage points.

perks.name: Peacemaker
perks.description: Once per week, the first eligible neutral stack that would fight lets you pass; you may still choose to attack.

effect.description: Once per week, the first eligible neutral stack that would fight lets you pass; you may still choose to attack.

perks.details: The first eligible neutral stack encountered each week that would otherwise initiate combat instead allows the hero to pass without fighting and remains on the map. The hero may still deliberately attack it through the ordinary encounter interaction.

perks.name: Envoy
perks.description: From up to 5 hexes away, reveal whether a visible neutral stack is willing to negotiate and the gold required if it joins.

effect.description: From up to 5 hexes away, reveal whether a visible neutral stack is willing to negotiate and the gold required if it joins.

perks.name: Mercenary Captain
perks.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy gain +1 Morale for their first three combats under this hero.

effect.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy gain +1 Morale for their first three combats under this hero.

perks.name: Common Cause
perks.description: Neutral creatures of the hero's faction count as half their normal Army Value when checking the Diplomacy threshold.

effect.description: Neutral creatures of the hero's faction count as half their normal Army Value when checking the Diplomacy threshold.

perks.name: Tribute
perks.description: Once per week, the first eligible neutral stack refusing to join accepts its recruitment cost in Gold and leaves, if your kingdom can pay.

effect.description: Once per week, the first eligible neutral stack refusing to join accepts its recruitment cost in Gold and leaves, if your kingdom can pay.

perks.details: Once per week, the first eligible neutral stack that refuses to join automatically accepts Gold equal to its normal recruitment value and leaves the map if the kingdom can pay that amount. If the treasury is insufficient, normal combat rules apply.

perks.name: Loyal Mercenaries
perks.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy do not contribute to mixed-faction Morale penalties while commanded by this hero.

effect.description: Creatures recruited through Diplomacy do not contribute to mixed-faction Morale penalties while commanded by this hero.

perks.name: Recruitment Pact
perks.description: After successfully recruiting a neutral stack, the next neutral stack contacted within 7 days is treated as 15% lower Army Value for the joining threshold.

effect.description: After successfully recruiting a neutral stack, the next neutral stack contacted within 7 days is treated as 15% lower Army Value for the joining threshold.

perks.name: Grand Diplomat
perks.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by a further 25 percentage points, to a maximum of 100% of the hero's Army Value.

effect.description: Increase the Diplomacy joining threshold by a further 25 percentage points, to a maximum of 100% of the hero's Army Value.

perks.name: Legendary Reputation
perks.description: Once per calendar month, the first eligible neutral stack that qualifies to join through Diplomacy joins without a gold payment.

effect.description: Once per calendar month, the first eligible neutral stack that qualifies to join through Diplomacy joins without a gold payment.

new-horizons:estates.name: Estates
new-horizons:estates.description: Increase income from Gold, mines, markets and towns.

basic.description: The kingdom receives +125 Gold per day while the hero is active.

effect.description: The kingdom receives +125 Gold per day while the hero is active.

advanced.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +250 Gold.

effect.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +250 Gold.

expert.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +500 Gold.

effect.description: Daily income from Estates increases to +500 Gold.

perks.name: Tax Collector
perks.description: Gain 100 Gold daily per owned town, up to 500 Gold.

effect.description: Gain 100 Gold daily per owned town, up to 500 Gold.

perks.details: Each active holder grants 100 Gold per day for each town owned by that hero’s player, capped at 500 Gold per holder per day. This is separate from the Estates core income.

perks.name: Land Surveyor
perks.description: The first mine captured by this hero each week immediately produces three days of normal output.

effect.description: The first mine captured by this hero each week immediately produces three days of normal output.

perks.details: Once each week, the first mine captured by this hero immediately grants three times its normal daily resource output. Merely visiting an already owned mine does not qualify; use this hero’s capture receipt, not a kingdom-wide mine-visit count.

perks.name: Prosperity
perks.description: While active, this hero grants 1 Wood and 1 Ore daily.

effect.description: While active, this hero grants 1 Wood and 1 Ore daily.

perks.details: Each active owned hero with Prosperity independently grants 1 Wood and 1 Ore per day through ordinary hero resource income. Garrisoned owned heroes count as active; tavern, pool, dead and non-owned heroes do not.

perks.name: Merchant Prince
perks.description: A town where this hero resides trades as though you owned two extra Marketplaces.

effect.description: A town where this hero resides trades as though you owned two extra Marketplaces.

perks.details: While this hero visits or garrisons an owned town with a Marketplace, that town’s exchange rates count two additional Marketplaces. Apply this once per town even when both residents own the perk; preserve ordinary Marketplace caps and ownership rules.

perks.name: Stewardship
perks.description: While stationed in an owned town, this hero grants 250 extra Gold daily.

effect.description: While stationed in an owned town, this hero grants 250 extra Gold daily.

perks.details: Each qualifying visiting or garrison hero stationed in an owned town grants that town 250 additional Gold per day. Two distinct qualifying residents each contribute; this does not scale with Lord Haart’s Estates core specialty.

perks.name: Conscription
perks.description: Creatures recruited directly into this hero’s army cost 10% fewer resources.

effect.description: Creatures recruited directly into this hero’s army cost 10% fewer resources.

perks.details: Apply the discount only when this hero is the actual recruitment recipient, including field dwelling and War Machine purchases. Recruitment into a town’s upper army uses its garrison hero; a town without a garrison hero receives no discount, even if a visiting hero owns Conscription. For each resource, charge ceil(undiscounted unit price × recruited count × 90 / 100), preserving zero costs. Ten units costing 1 Gold each therefore cost 9 Gold, rather than rounding each unit separately. Preserve normal recruitment availability, free sources, ownership and legal Command placement.

perks.name: Architect
perks.description: Buildings in owned towns where this hero resides cost 20% less Gold, Wood and Ore.

effect.description: Buildings in owned towns where this hero resides cost 20% less Gold, Wood and Ore.

perks.details: A qualifying visiting or garrison hero grants the owned town one 20% building discount. Charge ceil(ordinary cost × 80 / 100) separately for Gold, Wood and Ore; preserve zero costs and every precious-resource cost unchanged. Two holders do not double the discount. Keep ordinary ownership, building prerequisites and daily construction limits; displayed affordability and actual payment use the same price.

perks.name: Mercenary Company
perks.description: Each week, every owned mine gains Rogues equal to this hero’s current level.

effect.description: Each week, every owned mine gains Rogues equal to this hero’s current level.

perks.details: At the start of each week, every owned mine gains Rogues equal to each active holder’s current hero level; add qualifying holders’ contributions. Merge with existing Rogues or use a free native garrison slot. If all seven slots are occupied without Rogues, preserve undelivered guards in a pending reserve rather than overwriting troops or losing units. Keep native mine-garrison transfers and legal Command placement when a hero collects guards; this grants no additional Hero Action.

perks.name: Banking
perks.description: Each week, gain 1% of your Gold treasury, up to 1,000 Gold.

effect.description: Each week, gain 1% of your Gold treasury, up to 1,000 Gold.

perks.details: At the start of each week, each active holder grants floor(current Gold treasury / 100), capped at 1,000 Gold per holder. All holders use the same pre-income treasury snapshot; do not compound interest from another holder’s award or income just granted.

perks.name: Alchemist
perks.description: While active, this hero grants 1 Mercury, Sulfur, Crystal and Gems daily.

effect.description: While active, this hero grants 1 Mercury, Sulfur, Crystal and Gems daily.

perks.details: Each active owned holder independently grants 1 of each of the four precious resources daily: Mercury, Sulfur, Crystal and Gems. Garrisoned owned heroes qualify under ordinary hero income rules. Preserve independent resource specialties; this perk adds no Wood, Ore or Gold.

new-horizons:estates.details: Estates is available to all heroes. Its active hero daily Gold income remains 125, 250 or 500 at Basic, Advanced or Expert rank. Lord Haart’s existing specialty scales only that core income. Perk income and retained hero resource specialties keep their independent rules.

new-horizons:learning.name: Learning
new-horizons:learning.description: Increase experience gains and improve learning and teaching.

basic.description: Experience gained by the hero increases by 10%.

effect.description: Experience gained by the hero increases by 10%.

advanced.description: Experience gained increases by 20%.

effect.description: Experience gained increases by 20%.

expert.description: Experience gained increases by 30%.

effect.description: Experience gained increases by 30%.

perks.name: Scholar
perks.description: Meeting allied heroes teach each other all eligible unknown spells.

effect.description: Meeting allied heroes teach each other all eligible unknown spells.

perks.details: When two allied heroes meet and either has Scholar, each teaches the other every permanently known spell the recipient does not know and can legally learn. Apply ordinary School, map and spell-learning restrictions. There is no one-spell limit or weekly hero-pair limit.

perks.name: Historian
perks.description: Adventure-map objects whose primary reward is Experience grant 50% more Experience.

effect.description: Adventure-map objects whose primary reward is Experience grant 50% more Experience.

perks.details: Gain 50% additional Experience from adventure-map objects whose primary reward is Experience. Other reward types do not qualify merely because the object can also grant Experience.

perks.name: Mentor
perks.description: The first lower-level allied hero met each week gains 250 Experience per mentor level.

effect.description: The first lower-level allied hero met each week gains 250 Experience per mentor level.

perks.details: Once each week, the first eligible lower-level allied hero met gains 250 × the mentor’s level in raw Experience before that recipient’s ordinary Experience modifiers. Preserve Oris’s valid Mentor award bonus. Philosopher does not increase the number of recipients or replace this award with 500 Experience per level.

perks.name: Eagle Eye
perks.description: After combat, learn all eligible unknown spells cast by the enemy hero.

effect.description: After combat, learn all eligible unknown spells cast by the enemy hero.

new-horizons:divineMandate.name: Divine Mandate

effect.description: Your first damaging spell each round immediately repeats 25% damage against the same targets, free of Mana and Hero Actions.

perks.name: Arcane Singularity

effect.description: After reaching 10 Metamagic points, your spells cost 25% less Mana for the rest of combat.

new-horizons:shroudOfMalassa.name: Shroud of Nighon

effect.description: Friendly stacks move through occupied hexes and deal +25% flanking melee damage.

translations.new-horizons.creature.freezingTouch.help: Freezing Touch: each successful melee attack or retaliation has a %chance%% chance, rolled once after damage, to inflict physical Frozen. A subsequent ordinary physical creature attack deals +%bonus%% final damage and Shatters the ice, without retaliation. Direct magical damage breaks the ice without this bonus. translations.new-horizons.spellbook.targetUnknown: Potential effect before recipient limits or bonuses. No random proc is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.beforeDefenses: Potential damage before target defenses, immunities and recipient-dependent effects. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.followupBeforeTar: Potential follow-up damage before target defenses and other target-dependent modifiers. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.poisonTicks: Physical damage on the next three normal Creature Activations: the first tick is shown; the second deals 150% and the third 200%, each rounded down. No random proc is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.holyArmorRecipien: Current caster potential before any recipient-specific Crown and Altar bonus. The configured fixed reduction is not scaled.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.hexTrigger: Each eligible physical hit triggers the shown captured flat damage plus this share of actual damage. No random proc is assumed; recipient defenses and trigger eligibility remain separate.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.plagueSnapshot: Initial raw Plague tick snapshot before recipient effects or a random proc. Later ticks and child infections reuse this captured value; Empower is not added to this authored snapshot.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.regenerationRecov: This share of damage suffered by surviving creatures can be recovered at the start of their next activation, limited to wounds; casualties are not restored.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.minePlacement: Shown damage is per mine before recipient defenses or a random proc. Placement can be limited by legal empty ground hexes.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.reanimateRecipien: Current pool before the recipient is selected. It first repairs surviving wounds; Reanimator increases only the remaining casualty pool. Actual restored creatures depend on recipient wounds and casualty capacity.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.phantomRecipient: Caster-derived Integrity fraction shown to hundredths of a percent using the shared 10,000-HP reference. The chosen source stack supplies current HP; its actual Integrity pool is rounded down after scaling.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.doomRecipient: Reduces physical attack damage and Speed by the shown amount. Initiative changes only for a recipient with an explicit Initiative base; unknown target protections are not assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.recipientTierSpec: Current caster magnitude before recipient-tier specialty bonuses. Known flat and fixed caster overrides are already included; target attributes are not assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.stormCounts: Per-stack damage varies with the number of selected stacks, up to the spell's configured maximum. Actual legal counts depend on eligible targets. Range is before target defenses; no random proc is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.summonPlacement: Summoned HP pool. Actual creature count depends on the summoned creature's maximum HP, and placement must be legal.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.soulChainRecipien: Echo rate from the current hero. Actual damage depends on damage dealt to linked secondary stacks and the primary stack's defenses; no targets or random proc are assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.restorationRecipi: Current hero restoration pool before recipient-specific bonuses. Actual restored HP and casualties depend on the selected stack, its wounds, and spell-specific restoration rules.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.heavenlyGaleRecip: Current hero reduction of incoming physical projectile damage before recipient-specific Crown and Altar. Actual damage also depends on penetration, other defenses and the aggregate physical reduction cap; melee damage is unaffected.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.healthRate: Current caster damage rate before target defenses, rounded down to two decimal places. Actual HP damage is rounded for the selected stack; target-dependent specialties and defenses remain unknown.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.shadowGiftChoice: Range across the available sacrifice tiers. Actual tier and recipient HP cost are chosen when casting; Dark Gift reduces the sacrifice cost, not this offensive rate.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.naturesWrathRoute: First recipient potential before target defenses or missing-HP limits. Later hops attenuate through the captured route; actual recipients, defenses and wounds remain unknown.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.pandemoniumCount: Conditional damage at exactly one distinct debuff. Actual damage depends on the selected recipient's captured debuff count; the shared formula rounds the full aggregate once. No debuffs or recipients are inspected here.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.holyWrathRecipien: Lower value for an ordinary recipient; upper value for an undead or Inferno recipient. A recipient with both traits receives the multiplier once. Values are before recipient defenses.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.handOfFateSpill: Current primary damage before defenses. Spill is based on half the actual primary damage and the randomly selected recipient's defenses; no spill recipient or random outcome is predicted.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.soulReaperHealth: Current base damage plus the caster-adjusted missing-HP component rate. The combined amount is rounded by the actual caster damage stages, then recipient defenses and conditional execution apply. Unknown HP, execution and random procs are not assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.effect.purify: Remove up to %s effects per stack
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.purifyChoices: Maximum selectable negative spell effects per eligible stack. Actual removable effects and recipients depend on the selected area; Purifier's automatic physical affliction removal remains separate.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.chaosShieldCap: Current stored magic reduction. The spell also protects against physical damage, whose aggregate reduction cap may limit its benefit; attacker penetration and other sources are resolved against the chosen recipient.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.divineReflectionD: Maximum end-of-round reflection before unknown recipient-specific Crown and Altar. The shared payout uses 30% of actual HP damage taken, caps that amount, then applies Retributionist. Actual incoming damage, recipient bonuses and defenses remain unknown.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.misfortuneChance: Multiplier on explicitly affected favorable random creature abilities, relative to their ordinary chance. Caster enchantment overrides are included; unknown recipient-tier specialty adjustments are not assumed. No ability or random outcome is predicted. Luck penalties and other effects remain in the full description.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.verdantPlacement: Current hero HP pool before distribution over the legal ring. The actual ring, creature counts and placement remain unknown.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.transfigureFootpr: Conditional HP values for one-hex and two-hex obstacles. Actual HP uses the selected obstacle's full footprint and the same whole-pool rounding; no obstacle or creature count is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.earthquakeSiege: Current siege mode: structural damage per chosen section and the maximum section count. Actual eligible sections depend on the chosen location; no Luck outcome is assumed.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.earthquakeMode: Outdoor damage before recipient defenses, with conditional siege section count. In a fortified battle the row switches to structural damage per section. No targets, structures or Luck outcomes are predicted.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.vinesShape: Damage per intersected enemy stack before recipient defenses, plus the loaded movement Speed modifier. Each stack is hit once; actual recipients depend on the selected connected hexes. Initiative is unchanged.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.compactNotation: Compact large or fractional values may be rounded down. Scientific notation 1.23e6 means 1,230,000; D/H denote damage/healing HP, L denotes missing HP, and h denotes obstacle hexes.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.lifeDrainHealing: Potential damage before target defenses, immunities and recipient-dependent effects. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed. Healing restores the shown percentage of actual damage dealt, rounded down and limited by the friendly recipient's wounds; it does not restore casualties. H denotes that healing percentage.
translations.new-horizons.spellbook.lifeDrainFollowup: Potential follow-up damage before target defenses and other target-dependent modifiers. Optional cast settings use their unselected default; no random proc is assumed. Healing restores the shown percentage of actual damage dealt, rounded down and limited by the friendly recipient's wounds; it does not restore casualties. H denotes that healing percentage.
